# forward_collector_attachment (Resource)

Binds an already-registered collector to a network. Without one, a network cannot collect at all.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String)
- `username` (String) The collector's username, as it enrolled.

### Read-Only

- `collector_name` (String) Name Forward knows the attached collector by.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
